why: The record's hashed context mixer with bytes folded into a 130-way softmax, which about halves the cost of the head and cross entropy, and with table updates scaled to table size: the three smallest every batch, the largest every sixteenth. The saved ticks buy more training bytes. Mean of 3 fresh dev seeds; the seed used for selection (101) read 1.1433 and is excluded because this schedule was picked from about a dozen variants on that seed.
